text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking down the street—

text_block_list.name: Man in Black A
text_block_list.text:
...This way.
Hurry up.

text_block_list.name: Woman in Tuxedo
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to our company's casino game tournament!
All you wager against each other is your own pride.
Please enjoy this one-day-only competition♪

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sheesh. I thought I spotted a face that didn't belong, and of course it's you again.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, this is a clean and proper tournament, got it?
Even if an unregistered guy sticks his nose in—

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey. It's her...!
The legendary dealer, "Angel-sama"...!
Ah, to think I'd actually lay eyes on her in person...!!
choice_data_list: Angel-sama, as in the one from the riverbank before...?

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you guys are... hehe.
Long time no see.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, well. From the looks of it,
Angel-sama's quite the popular celebrity around here.

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
And the one chosen by that popular celebrity is you.
Well then—shall we wager our mutual pride?

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
An opponent personally picked by Angel-sama herself...?! 
Who is that... Horse Girl...?
Giggle, there's no way she can beat Angel-sama...

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
The game is roulette.
You place your chips, and I spin the wheel.
A straightforward, one-shot showdown.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Instead of numbers,
is it fine if I bet on color?

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
Sure. As long as you pick either Black or Red.
Well then... I'm spinning it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Angel-sama tosses the white ball onto the spinning wheel.
As the ball rattles pleasantly around the rim,
the surrounding crowd watches with bated breath—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Do you remember that talk about habits?
choice_data_list: If I recall, the one about Special Week...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. When it's crunch time in a match,
it puts anyone on high alert.
That's why habits form naturally. For instance—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The habit where, whenever Angel-sama aims for a specific pocket,
the rolling ball ticks out a distinct rhythm... for example.

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
choice_data_list: Can you really tell something like that?
Can you really tell something like that?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, with a dealer as famous as Angel-sama,
there's no shortage of material out there to study.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, anyone who lives on the track ends up training an internal "clock" to pace their laps.
Cross-reference that clock with the rhythm you analyzed, and—

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
—Tch, stop!
We're resetting this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The match was abruptly halted. A break was called,
and the game was set to restart once things settled down.
choice_data_list: If I hadn't spoken to you back then...
If I hadn't spoken to you back then...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Worried that my strategy went down the drain?
Haha... Don't sweat it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: All that talk about habits was a total bluff anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It worked like a charm, though. Seeing how rattled she got...
that should be enough to warn her that cheap tricks won't fly.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's head in.
—To a real test of luck, with no petty schemes attached.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Black it is, then.
Let's wager on Angel-sama's defeat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her declaration, the "Angel" calls out,
"No more bets!"
And the white ball spins round and round—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The venue erupts into an uproar.
The pocket the ball landed in was black.
The victor was... Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
But what caused a real commotion came right after. Having won,
she didn't take on any of the other gamblers
and promptly left the venue—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later. At the academy,
I spotted Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, it's you. Thanks for your help back then.
Though when things get that noisy,
anyone would make a break for it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I didn't go there to become popular,
I went to make a gamble.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke, a bus was waiting ahead.
...Come to think of it, I feel like I saw info
about her race entry on the news this morning.
choice_data_list: If I recall, you're the 8th favorite...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you knew? 
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, between black and white,
which one would you bet on?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Yeah, I'm betting on that color too.
Well then, see ya around.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I felt that no matter who she faced,
she would overtake them from behind and seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, between black and white,
which one would you bet on?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You don't have to force an answer.
Hesitation is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But I'm betting on white. Whoever the opponent,
I'll slip right past their throat at the wire... Later.
